_comment: QuantumOS review server (ADR-0028): Sashiko reviews of your own repositories, with your own model and key. Edit the binary, provider, model, key and repositories, then run `qos-review check --config review.json`. The key is never written here: key_env names a variable that holds it, or key_file an owner-only (chmod 600) file. max_total_tokens is required: the most uncached input plus output tokens one review may use, enforced by Sashiko. Prices are optional, in US dollars per million tokens, and only feed the estimates: the ones below are placeholders, so put in your provider's current prices for your model.
